work_done: Implemented Part A of Phase 1: project scaffold and core CLI. Added package.json (name wordcount-cli, bin wordcount, engines node>=18, scripts.test 'node --test', no dependencies). Added pure module lib/wordcount.js exporting countWords(text) (text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length) and formatCountLine(count, name). Added entry wc.js with shebang: reads process.argv.slice(2), loops per file reading readFileSync(file,'utf8') inside try/catch, prints per-file count line to stdout and accumulates a total, on error writes 'wc: cannot read <file>: <message>' to stderr and sets process.exitCode=1 while continuing, prints the total line after the loop, never calls process.exit(). Added fixtures hello.txt, two-lines.txt, empty.txt. Added test/wordcount.test.js (5 unit cases) and test/cli-basic.test.js (single-file, multi-file order, total via spawnSync). Full suite passes: 8 tests, 0 failures via node --test. Committed as 48b9924.
